title: A sundial drawn over a time input
blurb: A time input from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around a native input type="time": the canvas draws a stone sundial whose shadow falls where the sun puts it at the time in the field, and a drag round the dial sets the time.
question: Can an input type="time" stay the control while the canvas draws its value as the shadow on a sundial?
result: Yes in the test browser. The time input kept its value, its range and the form's validity while the canvas drew the shadow for that time, and a drag round the dial set the field. The shadow matched the engraved hour line to within 0.001°. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
